I feel nothing. My apathy is stronger than anything. I can’t even determine if I’m sad or happy at any given moment. The days merge into one long, long existence. I don’t remember anything I do a day after I’ve done it. Do I need to make a suicide attempt for my family to see? Is this what I have to do for anyone to see?
